dialogue.aiQuestion: Namaste! I am CarePath. Tell me what is bothering you today, or click a common symptom below.
dialogue.aiQuestionHi: नमस्ते! मैं CarePath हूँ। आज आपको क्या परेशानी हो रही है? नीचे बताएं या लक्षण चुनें।
dialogue.aiQuestionMr: नमस्कार! मी CarePath आहे. आज आपल्याला काय त्रास होत आहे? खाली सांगा किंवा पर्याय निवडा.
quickSuggestions: Mujhe fever aur thakan lag rahi hai
Chest pain aur saans lene me dikkat
Joint pain and swelling in knee

dialogue.aiQuestion: Fever kab se hai? (Since how many days have you had the fever?)
dialogue.aiQuestionHi: बुखार कब से है? कितने दिनों से तापमान बढ़ा हुआ है?
dialogue.aiQuestionMr: ताप कधीपासून आहे? किती दिवसांपासून कणकण वाटते आहे?

dialogue.aiQuestion: Approximate temperature kitna measure kiya hai? (What is the recorded temperature?)
dialogue.aiQuestionHi: लगभग कितना तापमान मापा गया है?

dialogue.aiQuestion: Kya koi red-flag symptoms hain jaise chest pain, saans lene me dikkat, ya behoshi? (Any severe breathing difficulty or chest pain?)
dialogue.aiQuestionHi: क्या सीने में दर्द, सांस लेने में तकलीफ या चक्कर आने जैसे लक्षण हैं?
dialogue.aiQuestionMr: छातीत दुखणे, श्वास घेण्यास त्रास किंवा चक्कर येणे अशी गंभीर लक्षणे आहेत का?
quickSuggestions: No, normal weakness and body ache only
Yes, chest pain and extreme shortness of breath

standardGuidance.reason: Based on the 2-day fever of 101°F with mild body weakness and no acute respiratory distress, consulting a local General Physician within 24 hours is recommended for clinical evaluation and routine laboratory tests.

emergencyGuidance.reason: The reported combination of chest tightness and shortness of breath requires immediate emergency clinical evaluation to rule out acute cardiopulmonary conditions.
